entries.title: Plates, Battle Effects & UI Polish Update
changes: This update completes additional Plate functionality, improves persistent battle effect indicators, polishes several menus and interfaces, and fixes multiple gameplay interactions reported by players.
🃏 PLATES & LASTING EFFECTS
Completed support for the remaining Plate effects.
Improved how active Plate effects are displayed during battles.
Added persistent Plate and Sphere aura indicators that remain visible throughout the battle.
Plate and Sphere indicators now appear on the side of the Pokémon affected by the effect.
Added support for displaying multiple active aura effects at the same time.
Additional aura indicators now wrap onto another row instead of extending into the opponent's side.
Hovering an active Plate or Sphere indicator now displays information about its effect.
Improved tracking and presentation of lasting battle effects such as Spheres and Trick Room.
⚔️ BATTLE & GAMEPLAY
Fixed several move and Ability interactions reported by players that were not activating their intended effects.
Improved interactions involving Evolution, Devolution and form changes.
Improved handling of Pokémon affected by persistent battle effects.
Improved several movement, Ability and special move interactions to better match the original Pokémon Duel rules.
Improved consistency of effects that modify or interact with Pokémon wheels.
Fixed additional cases where persistent effects could disappear after their initial activation.
🎨 BATTLE UI
Improved the positioning of persistent effects around the two battle wheels.
Adjusted the battle layout so both players have equal space on each side of the screen.
Improved active-effect visibility during wheel battles.
Added clearer separation between effects belonging to each Pokémon.
Improved stacking behavior when several persistent effects are active simultaneously.
👥 TEAM BUILDER
Standardized the Team Builder layout and spacing.
Online and Offline Team Builders now use consistent positioning and margins.
Improved top and bottom spacing throughout the Team Builder.
Adjusted title and content positioning to better match the rest of the game's menus.
📚 LIBRARIES
Improved consistency between the Figure Library and Plate Library layouts.
Moved Library Back buttons to the bottom of the screen.
Standardized top and bottom margins across Library screens.
Improved overall spacing and positioning to better match the rest of the game's interface.
📜 PATCH NOTES
